content: shadcn Sheet component (side='bottom') is built on Radix UI Dialog. Install: npx shadcn@latest add sheet. Use SheetContent side='bottom' for bottom sheet. Tailwind classes applied by shadcn handle slide-up animation via data-[state=open]/data-[state=closed] attributes. No custom CSS needed. For filter bottom sheet: SheetTrigger wraps the filter icon button; SheetContent side='bottom' contains the filter controls. Radix handles focus trap, overlay, keyboard Escape, and aria-modal semantics automatically.
